name: PricePress – Advanced Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
Are you looking for a powerful and free dynamic pricing for WooCommerce plugin? Do you want to move beyond simple, static pricing and implement a smart dynamic pricing model that increases your average order value? Welcome to PricePress.

PricePress is the simplest way to create advanced dynamic pricing for WooCommerce. This plugin allows you to easily set up powerful discount rules and dynamic pricing based on the quantity of products in a customer’s cart. It’s the perfect tool for implementing quantity dynamic pricing & bulk discounts, creating simple wholesale offers, or running promotional sales that encourage customers to buy more.

Unlike complex pro plugins, PricePress focuses on providing the essential dynamic pricing and discounts for WooCommerce features in a lightweight, intuitive, and easy-to-use package.

How PricePress Helps Your Business Grow

  • Implement a True Dynamic Pricing Model: Move away from one-price-fits-all. With PricePress, you can easily define dynamic pricing rules for WooCommerce, rewarding customers who purchase in larger quantities.
  • A Real World Example of Dynamic Pricing: Imagine you sell a product for $20. With PricePress, you can set rules so that if a customer buys 5 or more, the price drops to $18 per unit, and if they buy 10 or more, it drops to $15. This is all clearly displayed on the product page, encouraging larger orders.
  • Boost Sales with Quantity Discounts: The core of the plugin is WooCommerce quantity discounts. The more a customer buys, the more they save. It’s a proven strategy to increase revenue per transaction.
  • Clear & Transparent for Customers: The optional “Volume Discounts” table shows the per-unit price, making the value of the discount completely transparent. This builds customer trust and increases conversions.
  • Strategic Free Shipping Incentives: Create a powerful incentive to complete a purchase by offering free shipping when a customer buys a certain quantity of a product. Smart cart notices even tell customers how close they are to earning the reward.

Seamlessly Integrated with WooCommerce

PricePress feels like a native part of your store. All settings are located in a clean “PricePress” tab within the familiar WooCommerce product edit screen. There are no complicated global settings pages; you control the dynamic pricing in WooCommerce on a per-product basis.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the pricepress folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Edit a WooCommerce Simple Product.
  4. Click on the “PricePress” tab in the “Product data” section to configure your discount rules.
sections.faq:
What is meant by dynamic pricing?

Dynamic pricing is a strategy where the price of a product is not fixed, but changes based on certain rules or conditions. This is the opposite of static pricing vs dynamic pricing, where a product always has the same price. PricePress enables this by changing the price based on the quantity a customer adds to their cart.

Is dynamic pricing good for an ecommerce business?

Yes, absolutely! Ecommerce dynamic pricing is a powerful strategy to increase revenue. It allows you to create bulk discounts, reward loyal customers, and run targeted promotions that can significantly increase your average order value.

Can I use this for B2B or wholesale pricing?

PricePress is an excellent tool for setting up simple, product-level B2B dynamic pricing or wholesale-style discounts. For example, you can create a pricing tier for a high quantity (e.g., “Buy 50+ items”) that is only practical for business customers. It’s a great “lite” solution for wholesale needs.

Does this work with variable products?

This version is designed for Simple Products only.
